The Dell Precision 7560 is an amazing used laptop, but when it was previously owned by someone who smoked 69 packs a day, it's not so good.
Years of chain smoking had packed one of the fan bearings full of nicotine tar, so it died. What I pulled out of this thing was crunchy tobacco dust. I have no other way to describe it. Specs ended up being an 11th gen i7, 16GB RAM, and an RTX A2000 workstation GPU. And yes, it games.
The thermals on this workstation are some of the worst I've ever tested. The fan curve lets it sit at 100C for way too long before the fans even bother waking up. If you're thinking about buying one of these used, watch the temp test near the end.
